attributes.name: anchor
attributes.description: CSS selector used as the explicit element that receives the selected theme.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size preset forwarded to the trigger icon button: xxs, xs, s, m, l, xl or xxl.

attributes.name: ui-anchor
attributes.description: CSS selector used only to anchor the dropdown UI.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Color variant forwarded to the trigger icon button: neutral, brand, success, danger, warning or info.

methods.name: syncToMode(mode: TpThemeMode): void
methods.description: Synchronizes the mode from another controller.

events.name: tp-theme-change
events.description: Emitted when the effective theme applied to a target changes.
events.detail: { mode: "light" | "dark" | "auto"; theme: "light" | "dark"; anchor: string; target: HTMLElement }

events.name: tp-theme-refresh
events.description: Emitted when a controller asks other theme controllers to refresh their effective scope; source is the initiating controller and scope is its target element. This is a synchronization notification, distinct from tp-theme-change.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

dependencies.name: tp-divider
dependencies.summary: Visual separator for menus, dropdowns, toolbars, and layouts.

dependencies.name: tp-icon
dependencies.summary: SVG icon component with inline, URL, and registry sources.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-theme>` element implements the <tp-icon name="theme" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Theme functionality: parent-scoped theme switcher.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Theme button | Choose the light or dark appearance of the associated content. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate the focused button. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
